column1: # The platform's log mask: a text that is no field's value — a log line, an error, a JSON document, a connect
# string — with an Authorization header's credential, every name=value whose name is a secret's, and every address in
# it masked. No spec says it, and it is not secret_in.tsv's: those are a url field's values. Any implementation reads
# it as a process that knows the shared specs masks a log line (the names a spec adds — sig, psd — included).
# Columns, tab-separated, one row a line; a line that begins with '#' and an empty line are no row:
#   masked  what a log shows of it
#   note    why the row is here

column3: a connect string: the value runs to the end — more masked, never less
an empty value stays empty: not set is no secret
an address in a JSON text ends at its quote
a port followed by what closes a sentence is a number
a driver's RTSP client logs its request
a JSON pair whose name is a secret's is a pair too
the value runs to its closing quote, past an escaped one
a number is a value too
